name: doodle
title: Doodle
description: Single-line food drawings, as if done with a marker, in whatever colour the text around them is: a fork lifting a twirl of spaghetti, ravioli, gnocchi, a lemon, a tomato, basil, a whisk, a rolling pin, wheat and a steaming bowl. Inline SVG, one or two unfilled strokes each, with a band mode that lays a seeded row of them edge to edge as a section divider. Quiet is a still hairline; warm draws itself once as it scrolls into view and then boils a little; playful adds a bolder line and a wiggle when touched. Works under a strict Content-Security-Policy.

budget.reason: A component (decision 0005 and 0010: 36 KB with the pieces counted). Today about 32.6 KB: element 2.7 KB, pure core 10.3 KB (path reading, the boil, band laying, timing), the motif table 9.6 KB (ten drawings of curve data; a kitchen adds its own), the SVG builder 9.4 KB, three one-line skins. No frame loop: the reveal and the wiggle are Web Animations, and the boil is one shared 5 Hz timer that runs only while a doodle is on screen.
